end.summary:
Practised sorting wet and dry waste into green and blue bins.
Discussed compost pits, recycling, water saving, rainwater storage, trees, and school safety.
Anika correctly sorted banana peel, rice, tea leaves, potato peels, dal, plastic, and newspaper.
Anika initially included a spoon in compost; later stated that plastic must not go into compost because it does not rot.
Teach-back was not passed; lesson ended when Anika said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting waste, explaining composting, saving water, and keeping school areas green and safe. They used the method of checking whether an item is wet and can rot or dry and recyclable, and later corrected the mix-up that plastic does not belong in compost. At home, ask Anika to sort five household items and explain where each goes.
